premises.text: Purchasers in Africa pay much more for core commodities because logistics costs are far above parity with efficient markets
premises.evidence_span: When you purchase a product of good in Africa, you're paying a lot more than you should. Why? Because of logistics

premises.text: The haulage market has no flexibility or centralized coordination, so contracted trucks often fail to show and idle for days
premises.evidence_span: Because there's no flexibility or centralized coordination in the system

premises.text: Lorry optimizes African logistics with tech-enabled coordination, data-driven decisions, and journey-wide presence
premises.evidence_span: We are a tech-enabled logistics optimization solution that provides this flexibility and centralized coordination. Any point of the journey, we're there

premises.text: Addressable near-term market is large-volume commodity haulage (grains, fertilizer, cement, sugar) versus inner-city delivery competitors
premises.evidence_span: But Lorry is moving large volumes across Sub-Saharan Africa

value.text: Revolutionize continental logistics and lower goods prices for everyone
value.evidence_span: helping revolutionize the logistics system across the continent and bringing down the cost of goods

secondary_value.text: Peace of mind for cargo owners and transporters during stressful moves
secondary_value.evidence_span: peace of mind, which we found to be quite important in these stressful times

causal_links.evidence_span: you'd be paying up to one-third of the price that you're paying for many of your core commodities
providing data-driven decision making through our systems
We see 30% of this at least as addressable in the short term
